Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml

id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import base64, textwrap
script = r'''
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) "'!= 4) stop("Expected res97 res98 res99 output paths")
paths <- args[1:3]
names(paths) <- c("97", "98", "99")
out <- args[4]
read_res <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  rn <- attr(x, "rownames")
  ld <- attr(x, "listData")
  needed <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(ld))
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ",")))
  data.frame(
    gene = as.character(rn),
    baseMean = as.numeric(ld[["baseMean"]]),
    log2FoldChange = as.numeric(ld[["log2FoldChange"]]),
    padj = as.numeric(ld[["padj"]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
res <- lapply(paths, read_res)
universe <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, function(d) d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange)]))
if (length(universe) == 0) stop("Empty shared universe")
run_one <- function(genes) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(genes), universe)
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(character(0))
  ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = genes,
    organism = "pau",
    keyType = "kegg",
    universe = universe,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    use_internal_data = FALSE
  )
  tab <- as.data.frame(ek)
  if (nrow(tab) == 0) return(character(0))
  unique(as.character(tab$ID[!is.na(tab$p.adjust) & tab$p.adjust < 0.05]))
}
ids <- list(up = list(), down = list())
for (strain in names(res)) {
  d <- res[[strain]]
  ids$up[[strain]] <- run_one(d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange) & d$log2FoldChange > 1.5])
  ids$down[[strain]] <- run_one(d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange) & d$log2FoldChange < -1.5])
}
common_up <- Reduce(intersect, ids$up)
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, ids$down)
answer_ids <- union(common_up, common_down)
cat(length(answer_ids), "'"\\n\", sep = \"\", file = out)
message(\"universe=\", length(universe))
message(\"sig_up_counts=\", paste(names(ids"'$up), lengths(ids$up), sep=":", collapse=","))
message("sig_down_counts=", paste(names(ids$down), lengths(ids$down), sep=":", collapse=","))
message("common_up=", paste(common_up, collapse=","))
message("common_down=", paste(common_down, collapse=","))
message("answer_ids=", paste(answer_ids, collapse=","))
'"'''.strip()+\"\\n\"
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
